Nvidia chip buyers are told to rule out Chinese renters, sources say

Buyers of Nvidia chips have been told to rule out Chinese renters in order to buy GPUs, according to sources. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told CNBC's Squawk Box on Wednesday that the new BIS rule was intended to close 'loopholes.'

Reported by CNBC.
